now: Spider-Man's team of heroes, Storm among them, defeats the Red Skull and then Doctor Doom on the Beyonder's planet.
proposed: Spider-Man's team of heroes, Storm among them, enters Doctor Doom's peaceful New Latveria to rescue the Thing, and defeats Doom after he takes the Beyonder's power.
changes.evidence: The text sums up two episodes. The assault on the Red Skull's empire is #62 ('The Gauntlet of the Red Skull'); #63 ('Doom') opens after the Red Skull's defeat (Wikipedia: 'After defeating the Red Skull...'; Marvel Database lists the Red Skull in #63 only in flashback). #63's event: Doom kidnaps the Thing, the heroes enter his peaceful New Latveria, Doom absorbs the Beyonder, and the heroes defeat him.
